description: Source code for the GroupState trait in Apache Spark's Structured Streaming module, defining the interface for managing per-group state in streaming aggregations, including methods for state access, updates, timeouts, and watermark handling.

classes.name: GroupState
classes.description: A trait representing the interface for managing per-group state in Spark Structured Streaming, including methods for state access, modification, timeout management, and watermark retrieval.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if the state exists for the current group.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current state value; throws NoSuchElementException if state does not exist.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves the current state value as an Option.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the state with a new value.

methods.name: hasTimedOut
methods.description: Indicates whether the function was called due to a timeout.

methods.name: setTimeoutDuration
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration in milliseconds for the state, either as a Long or a String.

methods.name: setTimeoutTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the timeout timestamp as epoch milliseconds or as java.sql.Date, optionally with an additional duration.

methods.name: getCurrentWatermarkMs
methods.description: Returns the current event time watermark in milliseconds, or -1 in batch mode.

methods.name: getCurrentProcessingTimeMs
methods.description: Returns the current processing time in milliseconds.
